result.instructions: Tools for Castos, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my podcasts has the most recent episode, and when was it published?"; "Draft a new episode from this audio file and schedule it for next Monday."; "Add these three email addresses as private subscribers of my bonus feed.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Castos data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run castos_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run castos_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run castos_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. castos_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: castos_list_podcasts
tools.title: List podcasts
tools.description: List the podcasts on the authenticated Castos account, with title, description, language and feed settings. Castos API: GET /podcasts.

tools.name: castos_get_podcast
tools.title: Get a podcast
tools.description: Get one podcast by id, with its settings and metadata. Castos API: GET /podcasts/{podcast_id}.

tools.name: castos_update_podcast
tools.title: Update a podcast
tools.description: WRITE. Change the metadata of an existing podcast. Only the fields you pass are sent. It does not change the cover image, the feed redirect or the episodes. Castos API: POST /podcasts/{podcast_id}.

feed_episodes_number.description: Number of episodes in the RSS feed.

tools.name: castos_list_episodes
tools.title: List episodes
tools.description: List the episodes of one podcast, with id, title, created date and publish date. Castos API: GET /podcasts/{podcast_id}/episodes.

tools.name: castos_get_episode
tools.title: Get an episode
tools.description: Get one episode of a podcast by id, with its title, notes and audio details. Castos API: GET /podcasts/{podcast_id}/episodes/{episode_id}.

tools.name: castos_create_episode
tools.title: Create an episode
tools.description: WRITE. Add a new episode to a podcast. The audio is downloaded from episode_file_url (https, up to 40 MB) and uploaded to Castos. The episode may publish to the live feed at once, so check the publish date. Castos API: POST /podcasts/{podcast_id}/episodes (multipart).

episode_file_url.description: Public https URL of the audio file (up to 40 MB).

post_date.description: Publish date, yyyy-mm-dd or yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss.

tools.name: castos_update_episode
tools.title: Update an episode
tools.description: WRITE. Change the text or settings of an existing episode. Only the fields you pass are sent. To replace the audio, pass updated_episode_file as a public https URL. Castos API: POST /podcasts/{podcast_id}/episodes/{episode_id}.

updated_episode_file.description: New audio file as a public https URL.

post_date.description: Publish date, yyyy-mm-dd or yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss.

tools.name: castos_list_private_subscribers
tools.title: List private subscribers
tools.description: List the private subscribers of one podcast, one page at a time. Castos API: GET /private-subscribers.

tools.name: castos_get_private_subscriber
tools.title: Get a private subscriber
tools.description: Get one private subscriber by subscriber id. Castos API: GET /private-subscribers/{subscriber_id}.

tools.name: castos_get_private_subscriber_by_email
tools.title: Find a private subscriber by email
tools.description: Find a private subscriber by email. The reply lists the subscriber and its subscriptions; the subscription id is what castos_revoke_private_subscriber needs. Castos API: GET /private-subscribers/email/{email_address}.

annotations.title: Find a private subscriber by email

tools.name: castos_create_private_subscriber
tools.title: Add a private subscriber
tools.description: WRITE. Add an email address as a private subscriber of a podcast, so it can access the private feed. Castos API: POST /private-subscribers.

tools.name: castos_reactivate_private_subscriber
tools.title: Reactivate a private subscriber
tools.description: WRITE. Reactivate a private subscriber by subscriber id, for example after a revoke by mistake. Castos API: POST /private-subscribers/reactivate/{subscriber_id}.

tools.name: castos_revoke_private_subscriber
tools.title: Revoke a private subscription
tools.description: WRITE. Cancel one private subscription, so the subscriber loses access to that private feed. Pass the subscription id (see castos_get_private_subscriber_by_email). Castos API: POST /private-subscribers/{subscription_id}.

tools.name: castos_list_categories
tools.title: List podcast categories
tools.description: List the podcast categories that Castos accepts for the itunes_category fields. Castos API: GET /get-categories.

prompts.title: Get started with Castos
prompts.description: What you can do with Castos here, with example requests to try.
